insights.finding: Company revenue is -7.3% below budget over the trailing 3 months.
root_cause_chain: Region driver: North region is the largest negative contributor, running -14.5% below its budget.
Product driver: within North, Product B revenue is down -8.3% versus the prior 3-month period.
Root cause: average discount on Product B in North has increased by 2.0 percentage points over the same window, consistent with a pricing/competitive response eroding realized revenue.
insights.business_impact: At the current run rate, sustaining this discount level costs approximately ₹5.6 Cr in foregone revenue over 3 months for Product B in North alone, and is the single largest driver of the company-wide budget miss.
insights.recommendation: Freeze further discount escalation on Product B in North; run a win/loss review on recent deals to confirm whether the competitive threat is real or self-inflicted, and reallocate sales incentives toward higher-margin, on-plan products in that region while a pricing review is completed.

insights.finding: Company-wide cash conversion cycle has moved from 23 to 25 days, a deterioration of 2 days.
root_cause_chain: Region driver: East shows the sharpest DSO increase, up 4 days versus the prior period.
Root cause: extended payment terms granted to large enterprise accounts in East are slowing collections faster than payables or inventory are improving.
insights.business_impact: Every additional day of DSO ties up roughly ₹0.66 Cr of working capital in East alone, directly reducing free cash available for reinvestment.
insights.recommendation: Renegotiate payment terms on the top 3-5 overdue accounts in East, introduce early-payment incentives, and set a DSO ceiling as a regional finance KPI going forward.
